_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: <recipeId>-P<nnn>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

recipeId.description: Reference to u_mes_prod_recipe._id: the parent document this one belongs to

recipeName.description: Display value of recipeId, copied from u_mes_prod_recipe.name

sequenceNo.description: Position of this document in its list (within the same parent for child collections), starting at 1

name.description: Name of the recipe parameter; used as its display value in other collections

processTagName.description: Display value of processTagId, copied from u_mes_perf_processTag.description

unitOfMeasureName.description: Display value of unitOfMeasureId, copied from u_mes_mast_unitOfMeasure.name

isCritical.description: True when the record is critical

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
